title: Line sketch: Melting Blob Creature
description: Black-and-white ink line sketch on white paper — pure contour and edge drawing with no color fills. Edge-traced line art of: A large amorphous character with big eyes and a worried expression melts and drips downwards. Vibrant splashes and smaller melting forms surround the central figure against a fiery gradient background (derived from painting #679).
